fusions.name: Same Lesson Twice
fusions.desc: Strikes the target with your shell, which deals 4 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave it a [Slow Learner] for 8 seconds: your thorns hurt it more and barriers it strikes grow stronger.

fusions.name: Learned the Hard Way
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. The blow deals 18 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Testudo Drill
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Practised Routine
fusions.desc: Your ability cooldowns are 6% shorter and your armour rises by 8%.
